description: Source code for Http2DecoderAdapter class implementing HTTP/2 frame decoding and handling, including error management, frame parsing, and interaction with visitor interfaces.

classes.name: Http2DecoderAdapter
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HTTP/2 frames, managing decoding state, error handling, and notifying visitor interfaces.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data buffer, decoding frames until all data is consumed or an error occurs.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles the event when a frame header is decoded, validating frame type, stream id, and notifying visitor.

methods.name: DetermineSpdyState
methods.description: Determines the next decoder state based on the decode status after processing a frame.

methods.name: SetSpdyErrorAndNotify
methods.description: Sets an error state and notifies the visitor about the error.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is currently in an error state.

methods.name: frame_header
methods.description: Returns the current frame header being processed.

methods.name: stream_id
methods.description: Returns the stream ID of the current frame.

methods.name: frame_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the current frame.

methods.name: remaining_total_payload
methods.description: Calculates remaining payload size including padding if applicable.

methods.name: IsReadingPaddingLength
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is currently reading padding length.

methods.name: IsSkippingPadding
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is skipping padding bytes.

methods.name: IsDiscardingPayload
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is discarding payload due to an error.

methods.name: IsOkToStartFrame
methods.description: Determines if it is valid to start processing a frame with the given header.

methods.name: HasRequiredStreamId
methods.description: Validates that the stream ID meets requirements (non-zero or zero as needed).

methods.name: ReportReceiveCompressedFrame
methods.description: Notifies debug visitor about receiving a compressed frame.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoder
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HPACK decoder instance.

methods.name: CommonStartHpackBlock
methods.description: Begins processing an HPACK header block.

methods.name: MaybeAnnounceEmptyFirstHpackFragment
methods.description: Ensures that an empty HPACK fragment is announced if none was received.

methods.name: CommonHpackFragmentEnd
methods.description: Finalizes HPACK header fragment processing, notifying header end or errors.
